definition: production-image synthetic SFU capacity and account coexistence, v1

measuredTier.audio: all talk, synthetic broadband Opus, 64 kbps target

limitations: Disposable backend runs on production host; separate worker/DB/Redis, same image and 2GiB limit. Does not claim all production ancillary account services are represented.
Signaling travels over the SSH test tunnel; media travels directly over the network.
Synthetic audio proves transport and decoding, not physical speaker output or real mobile behavior.
Sixteen guests is a tested tier, not the server breaking point.
